page.layout: Running head and page number at top (DE GRATITVDINE. / 171). Below it a heading line "Decimum praeceptum." at full width. Then two text columns side by side with marginal notes: left column is italic verse text with a note-like block; the right column of the parallel pair holds a narrow column of roman text with a marginal note "Exod.20.v.17." at its top. Below the first pair, a full-width paragraph (Deut. 5.v.21). Then a lower pair of columns: left column with heading "XCIII." and italic heading "Quomodo diiuntur haec praecepta?" followed by running text; right column with a marginal note "Exod. 34. v. 28." and text, with a side note "Dominica" and "14." in the margin.

main_text.head: Decimum praeceptum.
main_text.p: Non concupiscες domum proximi tui, nec concupiscēs vxorem proximi tui, nec seruum eius, nec ancillam, nec bouem, nec asinum, nec quicquam eorum, quae sunt proximi tui. Exod. 20. v. 17. Non concupiscēs domum proximi tui, non concupiscēs vxorē proximi tui, neque seruum eius, neque ancillam eius, neque bouem eius, neque asinum eius, nec quicquam eorum quae sunt proximi tui.

Deut. 5. v. 21. Neque concupiscēs vxorem proximi tui, nec concupiscēs domum proximi tui, agrum eius aut seruum eius, aut ancillam eius, bouem eius, aut asinum eius, neque quicquam eorum quae sunt proximi tui.
main_text.head: XCIII.
Quomodo diiuntur haec praecepta?
main_text.p: In duas tabulas 4, quarum prior quatuor praeceptis tradit, quo pacto nos Exod. 34. v. 28. Dominica Mosis ibi cum Domino quadraginta dies & quadraginta noctes: panem non edit & aquam non bibit erga

page.notes: Left-column verse is printed in italic; marginal references and the right-hand side notes ("Dominica", "14.") are partly faint. The word "concupiscēs" and similar forms are copied as printed. Some words in the lower right column are uncertain at the edges of the scan.
